scope: semantic and process invariants for the isolated AGO dialogue experiment

invariants.text: Encoding may change while core semantics remain versioned and mappable.
Evidence asset identity is separate from described world object identity.
Observation is separate from Claim.
Copies sharing one lineage root do not increase independent observation roots.
Unknown, NotObserved, ObservedAbsent and NotApplicable are distinct.
Valid, observation, asset creation, represented, processing and transaction times are distinguishable.
Every wave field declares quantity kind, unit or normalized calibration, frame, domain and validity range.
Noise is a generator component and never becomes historical truth without evidence.
Necessary non-derivable detail is retained as residual or event.
Discrete identity, relation and event semantics are not forced into a spectrum.
Dimensional compatibility, boundaries, sources, sinks and conservation constraints are explicit when applicable.
Composition and phase are separate from visual material parameters.
Timeline navigation does not imply physical reversibility.
A conductor produces a versioned View and cannot silently rewrite evidence or identity.
Every View declares policy version, query scope, evidence set, omissions, uncertainty and transaction time.
Frozen checkpoints are append-only and permanently addressable.
No single global truth score automatically resolves all Claims.
Promotion requires critic, verifier, impact analysis and rollback pointer.
Cross-Mother coupling uses shared versioned Context, time and frame.
Duplicate AGO routes are stopped, merged or redirected by Judgment.
Historical error may remain as a Perceived World observation without becoming a Physical World fact.
Unresolved but potentially useful material is quarantined instead of promoted.
Local vocabularies map through extensions and do not alter the core metrology semantics.
Wenzhou is the first full regional score pilot while the core remains globally applicable.
